'''Enger Mowen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who ran the [[Imperial Recruitment]] Center in [[Isttu Village]] aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He started a rumor that he was really an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] sympathizer, and could direct people to join the Rebellion. In reality, he was using the information to seek out potential Rebels and pass their names to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Mowen was fat with unpleasant personal habits.
